notes.full427: Both fixed photos are less noisy than V65 but remain grainy and far below mature V60. Fabric edges/cloud/building geometry survive, but colored interpolation noise obscures fine cords and surface detail; exact GT is much cleaner.
notes.known: Colored grain persists in plate shadows and the white/green/black panel. Much noisier than the independent AHD reference, close to bilinear/noisy appearance; AHD is not exact RGB GT.
notes.unseen: Apple and tan/red surfaces retain heavy colored grain with some smoothing versus V65 but substantial residual noise. AHD is independent, not exact RGB GT.
notes.analytic: Weak carriers are accompanied by strong noise, including on neutral flats. Higher carrier gain does not establish useful detail recovery when the noise remains.
notes.gfx: Sky remains visibly grainy, and noise obscures truss/leaf/fence detail. Both full-frame output and native ROIs are valid, but this is poor restoration. ISO100 f/5.6 differs in aperture/time/motion and is not GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 dark rocks remain grainy; Sony is smoother than noisy input but retains fine noise and soft window geometry. GF50R concrete has strong grain and colored edging. RawNIND is smoother and is only a comparator, not GT.
notes.colored-CPU: Neutral/orange/cyan means are close to target but substantial colored noise remains; magenta also has coarse spatial variation. Lower residual noise than V65 is still visibly poor denoising.
notes.hue-grid: All three native previews retain substantial colored grain. The mean hue is reasonably close to GT, while spatial noise makes the result visibly poor.
